Familial Mediterranean Fever and MEFV Variants

Familial Mediterranean fever is a monogenic autoinflammatory disorder caused by mutations in the MEFV gene that mainly affects people of Mediterranean descent, with higher incidence in Turkish, Jewish, Arabic, and Armenian populations [6].
